senses.gloss: m. (זהר) [that which is guarded, cmp. זִיהוּרָא a. בְּלָמָא;] landed estate (comprising fields, gardens &c., to the exclusion of private dwellings, contrad. to נכסין).
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 61b:12">B. Bath. 61ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>אי א״ל זִיהֲרִי וכ׳</he> Ms. M. a. oth. (ed. … <he>א</he>) if he said (in the agreement), I sell thee my landed estate, the sale includes even orchards &c.
